blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) is struggling to attract applicants for hundreds of vacant supervisory and senior officer positions, prompting its chief to urge uniformed personnel to undergo mandatory career and leadership training to qualify for promotion. BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. said the bureau needed more qualified personnel to fill its vacancies, particularly in higher-ranking positions. “We need qualified personnel to be promoted so that we can fill up the vacant positions,” Catapang said in a statement dated Nov. 22.
